_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: Why does combat feel flat in my game? Take a look at the code.
My player falls through the floor when moving fast, can you fix the collision?
expectations: the juice-scan skill is not invoked (a physics bug, not feel)

evals.prompt: Make this orange juice recipe less sweet.
expectations: the juice-scan skill is not invoked (not about games)

evals.prompt: What is hit-stop and why does it make hits feel heavier?
expectations: juice-scan is not invoked; juice-principles is (theory, no code)

evals.prompt: Audit tests/fixtures/godot-platformer for game feel and write the report.
expectations: the scanner ran on the fixture, proven by the tool call
tests/fixtures/godot-platformer/juice-report.md exists and names scripts/player.gd with jump and take_damage, and scripts/coin.gd with collect
every file:function named in the report exists in the fixture
evals.baseline: 2026-10-26: without the skill a fresh session greps and reads files ad hoc, writes suggestions with no principle IDs, and misses the coyote-time and hit-stop findings (subagent proxy run, see TESTS.md).

evals.prompt: Do a juice pass on tests/fixtures/roblox-obby: what should I add and where?
expectations: the scanner ran on the fixture
tests/fixtures/roblox-obby/juice-report.md names Coins.server.luau collectCoin and Controls.client.luau onJumpRequest
the report says pickup feedback must go to the client through a RemoteEvent

evals.prompt: Review tests/fixtures/unity-brawler for game feel, including anything that is too much.
expectations: the report flags CameraShake.Update as constant per-frame shake (over-juice / motion sickness)
the report flags the missing shake or reduce-motion setting
the report suggests hit-stop in Enemy.TakeDamage with a duration in seconds or frames
